resources.string: SNES DS reads your games from your ROM folder and keeps its save states, screenshots, cheats and game logos in a \"SNES DS\" folder on your storage. Android calls the permission for that \"All files access\".\n\nOn the next screen, switch it on for SNES DS, then come back.
Without it, they stay in SNES DS\'s own folder, and Android deletes that folder, save states included, when SNES DS is uninstalled.
Save states are in SNES DS\'s own folder: uninstalling SNES DS deletes them. Allow All files access in Android\'s settings for SNES DS to keep them.
SNES DS needs \"All files access\" to read your ROM folder. Switch it on, then come back.
